# Aadarsh Thakur — Full Stack Developer & AI Engineer

> Portfolio, systems architecture, and research portfolio of Aadarsh Thakur. M.Tech candidate in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science at Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Patna. Full-Stack Software Developer with 1+ year experience building resilient web applications, cloud backends, and AI-integrated products.

## Core Specializations
- Full-Stack Web Development: React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap
- Backend & Distributed Systems: Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Firebase, REST APIs, Microservices, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning: LLM Integration, Computer Vision, Deep Learning, Generative AI pipelines
- Cloud & DevOps: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Firebase Hosting, Supabase RLS, Git, CI/CD

## Featured Engineering Projects
- [Escrow BMS](https://escrow-bms-6fdeb.web.app): Unified SaaS ERP suite uniting GST invoicing, automated payroll, double-entry Khaata ledger, CRM, and daily cash counter reconciliation.
- [Escrow Account Ledger](https://esrow-ledger.web.app): Production double-entry accounting ledger with Monday-final immutable transaction cutoffs and keyboard-first workflow.
- [ApexCRM](https://crm-f35c0.web.app): Enterprise CRM with interactive Drag-and-Drop Task Kanban boards, lead pipeline tracking, and won-deals auto-sync.
- [Escrow Payroll](https://escrow-payroll.web.app): Enterprise payroll computation engine with automated tax deductions, attendance aggregation, and PDF payslips.
- [Taliwo](https://taliwo.com): AI-powered resume and LinkedIn career optimization platform with automated scoring.
- [Revest](https://www.revest.co.in/): Multi-asset portfolio advisor suite with algorithmic risk rebalancing and PostgreSQL compounding analytics.
- [Clothez](https://clothez-4c565.web.app/): High-performance e-commerce storefront with client-side state caching and instant checkout.
